input.contract: Given an iterable of [start, end] integer closed spans, return a list of (start, end) tuples sorted by start, merging overlaps and spans that share an endpoint. The outer container must be a list and every span must be a two-element tuple. Merge [2, 5] with [5, 9], but do not merge [2, 5] with [6, 9]: integer adjacency is not endpoint contact. Empty input returns []. Reversed spans (start > end) raise ValueError. Do not mutate the input.
